content.short: Cardano Pet Registry is a blockchain pet ID system using QR tags, updatable records, and lost-pet alerts.
content.description: Cardano Pet Registry is a blockchain-backed identification system for pets. Owners can register a pet, connect it to a QR code tag, and keep contact information updated through the registry website. If someone finds a lost pet, scanning the tag opens the latest owner details and can trigger a location alert for the owner. The system uses Cardano records to give pet IDs stronger persistence while keeping the public experience simple. Its practical value is faster reunions for lost pets and easier record management.
